annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes Forsage as a way to make money with Ethereum, instructs viewers to sign up with a wallet and pay 0.05 ETH for its X3/X4 structure, and links registration and referrals to daily earnings while calling the platform safe and risk free. Although it claims profits can be made without referrals and denies being a Ponzi scheme, those statements do not resolve the depicted entry-payment and referral-linked structure.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central observed mechanism is a tiered X3/X4 matrix in which registration and participant referrals are linked to profit claims. The frame shows the X3/X4 matrix structure, while the source explicitly links payment to the numbers of referrals after registration.
